verdict.rationale: Linear's integration directory documents a first-party Figma integration that lets users create and link Linear issues directly from Figma. This is a genuine in-design-tool workflow, but it covers issue creation and linking, not keeping project status current. missing for 10: evidence of viewing or updating issue/project status from inside Figma or another design tool, in-depth Figma integration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration from designers.
